title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am working for one company in Saudi. Now they are going to transfer me in other country.Here I have to stay in company staff house with non-muslims.I have to cook and share the food with company people.But they are frequently drinking alcohol. and sometimes during cooking they use to drink.I have no option to eat outside as there is no nearby restaurant.So, in this case is it allowed to stay with them and eat with them or is there any other option. please advise me as soon as possible. 1655 views Q. I want to clarify whether doing a job in the Information Technology department at a conventional bank is right or not. Being an IT professional, our duties and responsibilities are only fixing, installing, configuring, and maintaining IT tools like computers, software, ATM machines, and day to day operational engineering activities. As far as financial matters are concerned we have an expense budget to purchase expensive equipments but we do not know the source of these funds; whether they are riba based or profit based. In fact we don't know the source of our salaries either. My senior in bank has told me that he has verbal permission from Darul Uloom Karachi that an IT department job in a bank is permissible. Please clarify if this is permissible or not according to above stated job responsibilities. 4244 views Q. Dear Mufti sb, AOA, My question is that can we use contraceptives for the purpose of keeping gap between children AS PER THE FOLLOING CONDITIONS: 1. so that I and my wife can focus our full attention on the brought up of our earlier baby i.e her food,clothings,health etc, beacauze we think its our very important responsibility. 2. so that my wife can maintain her beauty for me for longer time period, which we think is not possible without having some gap between children. Mufti sb due to the above mentioned fact I once again ask my question, that whether can we use contraceptives for gap, and if yes, what method is allowed? May ALLAH increase you in knowledge that result in your and ours success of both worlds. AMEEN 2485 views Q. I would like to know that i have some fixed dipposite in Bank & Insurance and the bank and the insurance companies are returning some interest on my fixed dispposite. 1721 views Q. Is it permissible or makruh by men to listen to audio hamd and naats sung by women? and for women to listen to naats sung by men? and what about bayaans? 2398 views Q. i am a working women and iam working with full hijab. my husband says that i should do all outside work like bringing grocery,taking children to doctor wen they are ill,paying bills etc .my house is little far from main road .i have to go there to take auto.i am having very difficult to do outside work because i have to walk little distance to take auto.i want to ask u that in these circumstances can i drive a car to complete my outside work. i have a car but i cant keep driver becoz i cant afford it.so,please let me know whether can i drive a car because i only have to do all work? 3357 views Q. Doing zikr loudly in the mosque and cause disturbance to others 7187 views Q. Regarding haram and halal 1898 views Q. assalamualaikum i want to ask that is female circumcision allowed in islam.Is it forbidden or mandatory? 3378 views Q. What do ulama say about Digital Camera? Is it permissible to takr pictures on digital camera? 4436 views Q. Asalamu alaykum. I am an American Convert. Have been muslim for 1 year and 5 months now. I am currently talking to a man from Egypt regarding engagement/marriage. He's going about it the proper way by talking to my guardian (since my father is not muslim) and his parents have agreed. But now I have a big problem. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Out of respect for him and because I knew that I would need to for marriage anyway I did this. But now he still has sisters who he works with or who are students that he advises on his account. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). Is this simply a cultural issue or is there some proof in Quran and Sunnah. I know it's hard because it's over the internet, but what can I do? Is it right for him to keep his female aqaintances when I can't? I've told him my feelings and I don't like it. Another problem I have is that I can't usually read what these women comment on his profile either as it's in Arabic and I speak very little. Please help. 2239 views Q. I am a student. To pay my fees and meet my expenses i have to work part-time.Am i allowed(is it permissible) to work for a store which has lottery in it?I will have to operate the lottery machine also along with the cash register.2).Is it permissible to work for a jewellery store which sells christian symbols like cross and replicas of jesus christ.please reply. 2399 views Q. Me and my father are involved in export of frozen meat. 1590 views Q. Is Masturbating in islam halal or haram? And if its haram,how can i protect me from masturbating and what is the "kaffara" of masturbating? 31019 views Q. Use of electric rocket 7271 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 158404 Country: India Title: Job in IT company Question: I work in an IT company. The nature of work of my company is to provide and support different products to Bank globally. I am working on one of the products which is used to transfer money online. My work involves testing of the application which is used by banks (not Islamic of course). I would like to know, is my earning and work halal? Answer ID: 158404 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 573/540/M=6/1439) If your task in the above mentioned company does not involve writing and calculating interest and interest based dealing then your job and income shall not be termed haram and unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
